University of Maryland Greenebaum Cancer Center Flow Cyotemtry Shared Service 

 

STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE TO MEASURE FLUORESCENT REPORTER FREQUENCY 

 

 

INSTRUMENTS: 

 

BD FACS CANTOII 

BD LSR II 

 

MATERIALS AND REAGENTS: 

 

BD FACS Tubes (BD Biosciences #352058) or 96 well U or V-bottom plate 

Ice bucket with ice 

Vortex mixer 

Filter 40m filter or BD Filter cap FACS tubes (BD Biosciences #352235) 

Culture media or FACS buffer (PBS with 1-2% BSA) 

 

CELL PREPARATION: 

 

Remove cells from tissue culture dish.   

Non-adherent cells – Decant and spin to concentrate. 

Adherent cell - Use trypsin or other enzymatic on  non-enzymatic non-mechanical procedure. Do not scrape cells! 

Wash/concentrate cells by spinning in centrifuge. 

Make sure to obtain single cell suspension in culture media or FACS buffer. 

Count cells using a haemocytomer or other cell counter. 

Adjust cell density to 2 million cells/ ml. Minimum volume is 250l! 

Filter cells on 40m filter or BD Filter cap FACS tubes. 

Keep cells on ice  or at 4oC until analysis. 

 

CONTROLS: 

 

Untransfected negative control.   

Single fluorescent protein (FP)-transfected positive control. If more than one FP is used in experiment, a single-transfected positive control must be provided for each different fluorescent reporter! 

 

FLOW CYTOMMETRY ANALYSIS: 

 

Follow SOP for sample acquisition on BD FACS Canto II or BD LSR II analytical instruments.   

Data analysis – with FACS Diva (BD Biosciences) or Flow Jo (TreeStar, Inc.).
